# Gate 1 measurements (generated by `cargo run --release`)

Page size 4096; frame = 4120 bytes; estimate = 2 x pages(row maximum) summed + 16.
`frames` is what the WAL hook reported after the commit (cross-checked against the log file length). `peak` is the largest total of database + log + wal-index + other files above the starting total, in pages, from samples after each statement (`s`) and with a 100 microsecond poller as well (`p`). Rolled-back transactions have no commit, so no frame count: only the peak is bounded.

## cache_spill ON, cache_size -64 (64 KiB = 16 pages), Fresh database

| operation | estimate | hook calls | frames (hook) | frames (file) | peak s / p | verdict |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |
| insert 512 KiB blob row | 272 | 1 | 134 | 134 | 135 / 135 | PASS |
| update 512 KiB blob row | 272 | 1 | 131 | 131 | 132 / 132 | PASS |
| delete 512 KiB blob row | 272 | 1 | 137 | 137 | 138 / 138 | PASS |
| insert 64 KiB envelope row | 48 | 1 | 20 | 20 | 21 / 21 | PASS |
| txn: update two 512 KiB rows | 528 | 1 | 262 | 262 | 264 / 264 | PASS |
| txn: insert two 512 KiB rows | 528 | 1 | 266 | 266 | 268 / 268 | PASS |
| txn: update two 512 KiB rows, ROLLBACK | 528 | 0 | n/a (no commit) | 251 (log bytes 1034152) | 253 / 253 | PASS |

## Informational: `PRAGMA incremental_vacuum(256)` after deleting four large rows (no pass/fail rule)

Free pages before 918, after 662; frames appended by the vacuum step: 2.

**Overall: every case within its estimate**
